title: One dead, 3 injured in head-on crash on the Cape
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: A head-on crash in Sandwich on Sunday night killed one and injured three on Farmersville Road.
The collision involved a 2011 Toyota Prius traveling west and a 2017 Toyota RAV4 going east.
The Prius driver died at Cape Cod Hospital; RAV4 occupants sustained nonlife-threatening injuries.

title: Driver on South Shore narrowly escaped before commuter train totaled his Camry
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: A 33-year-old Mansfield man made a wrong turn onto South Shore railroad tracks, causing his car to get stuck.
An MBTA Commuter Rail train struck and totaled the 2016 Toyota Camry at North Main Street grade crossing.
All 15 train passengers and the crew were unharmed; North Main Street was closed for over two hours.

title: Livestream: Lindsay Clancy murder trial continues with psychiatrist under cross-examination
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Lindsay Clancy's murder trial continues with her psychiatrist, Dr. Jennifer Tufts, under cross-examination in Plymouth.
Dr. Tufts testified Clancy denied suicidal or homicidal thoughts before the Duxbury incident involving her three children.
Clancy's defense argues her postpartum mental illness and medications contributed to her actions on January 24, 2023.

title: For $415k, you can live in a New England community library
author: Megan Johnson
bullets: The Tyler Free Library in Foster, R.I., originally a schoolhouse from 1850, is for sale at $415,000.
The 1,760-square-foot property features hardwood floors, cathedral ceilings, and a fireplace, and is on one acre.
Books from the library are not included in the sale; they will be transferred to the Foster Public Library.

title: Patriots 53-man roster projection 1.0: Will New England really stick with 7 receivers?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Patriots' roster projection includes seven wide receivers, with uncertainty surrounding Kayshon Boutte's role and potential trade.
Rookie quarterback Behren Morton likely to be retained, potentially developing into a backup behind starter Drake Maye.
Linebacker depth remains a concern for Patriots, with rookie Khalil Jacobs pushing veteran K.J. Britt out of contention.

title: Adley Rutschman could make his Red Sox debut in coming days
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Adley Rutschman, recently traded to the Red Sox, may debut in Toronto after recovering from wrist inflammation.
Rutschman played two rehab games with Triple-A Worcester, showing activity with a double and two walks.
Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy indicated Rutschman could join the lineup later in the Toronto series.

title: Healey signs bill allowing state to take Norwood Hospital through eminent domain
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Governor Maura Healey signed a bill allowing Massachusetts to seize Norwood Hospital through eminent domain for redevelopment.
The law enables the state to take the 11-acre site from Medical Properties Trust and lease it to a nonprofit.
Norwood Hospital has been vacant since 2020 due to floods; construction stalled when Steward Health Care ceased payments.

title: Dozens displaced by building collapse in Springfield
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A building collapse in Springfield, Massachusetts, displaced 45 people due to severe thunderstorms and intense winds.
Mayor Domenic Sarno declared a state of emergency, as the storm caused power outages and downed trees in the area.
The Red Cross and Eversource crews from Connecticut are aiding the response and recovery efforts for affected residents.

title: Adam Vinatieri jokes about Bill Belichick, Deflategate as part of Hall-of-Fame speech
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Adam Vinatieri was inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame, reflecting on his 24-year NFL career.
Vinatieri joked about Bill Belichick being absent due to his role at UNC and judging a cheerleading competition.
He humorously referenced the Patriots' 'Deflategate' controversy during his Hall of Fame speech.

title: Mass. 7-year-old hit and killed by vehicle while riding bike
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A 7-year-old was fatally struck by a vehicle while riding a bike in Williamstown, Massachusetts on Friday.
The accident occurred at Main Street and Buxton Hill Road; the child entered Main Street unintentionally, DA's office reported.
No arrests or charges filed; driver not impaired by drugs or alcohol; the incident is under investigation.
